data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name Yosef, meaning 'God will add' or 'God increases'. In the Old Testament, Joseph is the name of a famous Israelite who was the favorite son of Jacob. He was sold into slavery by his brothers but eventually rose to become a powerful Egyptian leader. The name Joe carries the meaning “God will add (Joseph)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joe usually hope their child will grow to embody god will add (joseph) and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Τζο
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Τζο είναι μια σύντομη μορφή του ονόματος Ιωσήφ, που σημαίνει 'ο Θεός προσθέτει'. Το όνομα Ιωσήφ προέρχεται από τις εβραϊκές λέξεις 'אלוהים' και 'יוסף', που σημαίνει 'και προσθέτει'. Ο Ιωσήφ ήταν ένας από τους δώδεκα πατριάρχες της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης και ήταν γιος του Ιακώβ.

in_latin.name: Ioseph
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ioseph est forma completa nominis Ioe, quod significat 'Deus addit'. Nomen Ioseph derivatur ex hebraicis verbis 'אלוהים' et 'יוסף', quod significat 'et addit'. Ioseph fuit unus de duodecim patriarchis in Vetere Testamento et fuit filius Iacobi.

in_english.name: Joe
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joe is a shortened form of Joseph, which means 'God will add or increase'. The name Joseph originates from the Hebrew words 'אלוהים' (Elohim) and 'יוסף' (Yosef), meaning 'God will add'. Joseph was one of the twelve patriarchs in the Old Testament and was a son of Jacob. The name Joe has been popularized in Christian tradition as a symbol of faith and divine providence.

For instance, "Joe Six-Pack" is a colloquial term used to describe a regular working class man. In literature, the name "Joe" has been used to symbolize the everyman or the common man. Joe Strummer, a famous British musician, named his band "The Clash," which became synonymous with rebellion and defiance.
data.spiritual_significance: The sacred spiritual significance of the name "Joseph" in the Old Testament tells us that God adds or increases His blessings to those He loves. This can be seen in the story of Joseph, who, despite being sold into slavery, became an instrumental figure in his family's prosperity. As a Christian name, "Joe" can be seen as a reminder of God's presence and blessings in our lives. It can serve as a constant reminder that no matter what challenges we face, we can always trust that God is adding and increasing His blessings in our lives.
